## Verification

- [ ] `python3 scripts/validate_public_content.py .`
- [ ] Links and representative instructions checked
- [ ] Exact claims match opened public evidence and changeable facts were rechecked
- [ ] Commands, examples, versions, dates, counts and states were verified where used
- [ ] Public copy follows `PUBLIC_COMMUNICATION_STANDARD.md`, with em dashes and generated writing patterns removed
- [ ] Reviewer other than the author checked facts and natural language; name the reviewer. When the maintainer is the author, a different model family performs this review and the maintainer records self-approval
- [ ] No customer, personal, credential, infrastructure, recovery or private repository information
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated, or no user-visible change because:
